title: Gemcut
body:
Syntax: gemcut <gem>

Hold a Copper Chisel (VNUM 20803). Every bonus gem found while mining can be cut: Rough Quartz, Jade, Amber, Garnet, Amethyst, Topaz, Sapphire, Emerald, Ruby and Diamond. Legacy Raw Sapphire, Raw Ruby and Raw Diamond are also cuttable.

Gemcutter job levels: Quartz 1, Jade 10, Amber 20, Garnet 30, the five elemental gems (Amethyst, Topaz, Sapphire, Emerald, Ruby) 60, Diamond 80. Each cut takes stamina and one chisel use.

Cut gems can be added during new equipment forging (choose metal "iron with ruby") or embedded in an existing uniquely named forged weapon/armor with 'inlay <item> with <gem>'. Cut gems carried but not inlaid grant no combat stats. See help inlay.

Date: 2026-11-02
